Services

Trees, stumps, brush and beds.

Homes in town and acreage outside it. Call or text a photo and George will tell you what it takes.

  • Tree trimming

    Oaks shaped, low limbs raised off roofs, drives and fences.

  • Stump grinding

    Leftover stumps ground down so you can mow, plant or build over them.

  • Brush & limb haul-off

    Downed limbs and trimmings loaded up and hauled away.

  • Ranch maintenance

    Fence lines and pastures cleared with skid steers and a grapple.

  • Rock beds & edging

    River rock beds over landscape fabric with steel edging.

  • Gravel paths & pads

    Decomposed granite walks, gravel pads and fire pit areas with timber borders.
